Messages.Author: Orpheus
Messages.Body:
Repulsion, Action Modifier, Obeah/Presence, no cost
[pre]: Only usable when the acting vampire's action is announced. If
this action is blocked, the acting vampire gets 1 optional maneuver,
only usble to maneuver to long range, during the resulting combat.
[obe]: +1 stealth. [OBE]: Put this card on this vampire. This vampire
gets +1 stealth. Burn this card if this vampire goes to torpor. This
vampire with Repulsion cannot have or play another Repulsion.

If you're trying to equip with a Repulsion in sup, and you get blocked, can
you use another repulsion in inf to get the necessary stealth ?

--
Yours,

Orpheus, Prince of Marseille

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
Orpheus wrote:
>
> Repulsion, Action Modifier, Obeah/Presence, no cost
> [pre]: Only usable when the acting vampire's action is announced. If
> this action is blocked, the acting vampire gets 1 optional maneuver,
> only usble to maneuver to long range, during the resulting combat.
> [obe]: +1 stealth. [OBE]: Put this card on this vampire. This vampire
> gets +1 stealth. Burn this card if this vampire goes to torpor. This
> vampire with Repulsion cannot have or play another Repulsion.
>
> If you're trying to equip with a Repulsion in sup, and you get blocked, can
> you use another repulsion in inf to get the necessary stealth ?

Repulsion is not equipment.
Repulsion is not an action and therefore cannot be blocked.

--
